description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableSubject' which implements the 'Subject' interface. It provides methods for creating Subject instances, converting from JSON, and serializing to JSON, indicating its role in managing subject data within a policy or security context.

classes.name: ImmutableSubject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subject interface representing a security or policy subject with a unique ID and type.
